mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Orders (order_id, user_id, account_id, instrument_id, side, order_type, limit_price, quantity, executed_price, status, idempotency_key, fee_rate) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{accountUuid}, #{instrumentId}, #{side}::order_side_enum, 'LIMIT'::order_type_enum, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{executedPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{status}::order_status_enum, #{idempotencyKey}, #{feeRate})
INSERT INTO Trades (order_id, execution_price, execution_quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{executionPrice}, #{executionQuantity})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, a.id AS account_id, i.ticker AS symbol, o.side, o.quantity, o.limit_price AS price, o.executed_price, o.status FROM Orders o JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE Orders SET status = 'CANCELLED'::order_status_enum WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('NEW'::order_status_enum, 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'::order_status_enum)
UPDATE Orders SET published_at = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, a.id AS account_id, i.ticker AS symbol, o.side, o.quantity, o.limit_price AS price, o.idempotency_key, o.placed_at FROM Orders o JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.status = 'NEW'::order_status_enum AND o.published_at IS NULL AND o.source = 'PORTAL' AND o.placed_at < #{placedBefore} ORDER BY o.placed_at LIMIT #{limit}
